recommendation: Use the first three preregistered reserved seeds for a bounded paired screen of weighted versus unweighted task models against round2 and market, swapping seats.
budget: 24 complete official games, 24 primary replays and one separately bounded replay; the other three reserved seeds are not an adaptive supplement.
metrics: Per-seed paired own profit, opponent profit, cash margin and win/draw/loss score; fixed 10000 cluster bootstrap draws are descriptive only.
guardrails: Each seed/opponent/seat own-profit and margin difference >= -2000; each seed/opponent seat-average >= -1000. Any missing or failed game terminates without retry or replacement.
limitations: Three seed clusters cannot establish statistical significance or promotion. Sampled host memory and Windows Job cleanup are not hard realtime limits.
